lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a consistent rectangular grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical gradient, with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge transitioning to a shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs visible within the interior region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
